name: project-nomad
description: Project NOMAD is an offline-first knowledge and education server. Wikipedia, thousands of books, courses, maps, and optional local AI, all running on hardware you own with no internet required.
one_liner: A little box you set up once that gives you Wikipedia, thousands of books, courses, maps, and even an offline AI chatbot, with no internet connection needed at all.
buyer: A rural school administrator, off-grid homesteader, or disaster-preparedness organization that needs reliable access to knowledge and education in places without dependable internet.
business_use_cases: A prepper/outdoor-gear retailer bundles a pre-configured NOMAD device as a premium add-on to emergency kits.
An NGO deploys it in rural schools or refugee camps that lack reliable internet, as part of an education program.
A boat or RV outfitter sells it as an offline entertainment-and-reference package for long trips with no connectivity.

money_ideas.idea: Sell pre-built, plug-and-play NOMAD hardware boxes to preppers, off-grid communities, and RV/boat owners.
Offer paid setup and content-curation service (custom book/course packs) for schools and NGOs deploying it at scale.

steal_this: Buy a cheap mini-PC, install NOMAD, and sell it pre-loaded as a 'grab-and-go offline library' on a marketplace like Etsy or a local prepper forum this weekend.
